description: This file contains a class named TH2 which provides helper methods for throwing common exceptions like InvalidOperationException and NotImplementedException, mainly used for internal debugging or error handling within the PDFsharp library.

classes.name: TH2
classes.description: A helper class for throwing exceptions, used internally within the PDFsharp library for error handling.

methods.name: InvalidOperationException_ToDo
methods.description: Creates an InvalidOperationException with an optional message indicating a 'to do' placeholder.

methods.name: ThrowInvalidOperationException_ToDo
methods.description: Throws an InvalidOperationException with an optional message.

methods.name: NotImplementedException
methods.description: Creates a NotImplementedException with an optional message and inner exception.

methods.name: ThrowNotImplementedException
methods.description: Throws a NotImplementedException with an optional message and inner exception.

methods.name: ThrowInvalidOperationException_HandleIsNotPinned
methods.description: Throws an exception indicating that a handle is not pinned (internal error condition).
